What we typically share to help procurement: 3 sample unit economics scenarios so you can see $/1M token sensitivity. Can you confirm if the production target is closer to 30M or 60M? Also please share any procurement constraints (quarterly vs annual PO, supplier onboarding timelines).

Attachments: MutualActionPlan.docx (draft MAP with milestones) — I attached a quick draft to drive the conversation.

Next steps proposed:
1) You confirm target monthly avg and budget band (e.g., $500- $1,000 per 1M tokens)
2) I’ll send a pricing options doc with baseline hosted API rates, committed-use tier examples, and startup program terms by early next week
3) Quick follow-up with procurement (15-20m) to align on timelines

Hi Eve —

Great, thanks for the clarity — helpful to see the ramp plan and budget band. Attached is a short pricing options sheet (high-level; final terms depend on SOW and legal). Summary below — examples assume model family M-gen (generation-heavy).

1) Public hosted API (no commit)
- Baseline list: $1,200 / 1M tokens
- Good for pilots / unpredictable volume

2) Committed-use (12-month) 
- 12mo tier examples (monthly avg commit):
  - 30M avg: 20% discount -> ~$960 / 1M tokens
  - 50M avg: 25% discount -> ~$900 / 1M tokens
- Billing: monthly invoice against committed quantity; overages billed at baseline list

3) Multi-year (24-month) / larger commit
- 24mo examples:
  - 30M avg: 25% discount -> ~$900 / 1M tokens
  - 50M avg: 30% discount -> ~$840 / 1M tokens
- Additional incentives: onboarding credit (typically $10k- $25k depending on commit) and a dedicated SRE onboarding window for production readiness

4) Startup program (qualifying early-stage companies)
- Standard startup: one-time credits (eg $15k), 15% off committed tiers for first year; faster procurement checklist support
- For DeepFin: if you share incorporation date and funding stage we can confirm eligibility and proposed credit amount

Ask: can you confirm which of the above you'd like modeled (pilot + 12mo commit vs. pilot + 24mo commit)? If you want, I can prepare a table showing monthly invoice examples at 8M, 30M, and 50M token levels with both committed and non-committed pricing.
